journey.name: app status emergency exit
journey.description:
While an emergency exit is active, App Status shows an "Emergency Exit" row under Lightning Connection. It reads "Fee funding needed" while the exit asks for fee funding and "In progress" otherwise, including while a payment that covers the funding waits to confirm. The row opens the exit's progress screen, and leaving that screen returns to App Status. With no active exit the row is absent. An exit paid from savings cannot be cancelled and runs for days, so the row's removal once an exit ends is covered by unit tests, not here. An exit takes Spark off the Lightning rail, so with no usable channel Lightning Connection stops reading "Using Spark" while it runs.
Precondition: dev build on regtest with Spark connected, a Spark balance and savings that can pay the exit's fee funding. The wallet has no Lightning channel. Start an emergency exit from Spark (spark emergency exit journey), pick "Pay from savings" and swipe to start it. Starting an exit takes the Spark balance out of Spending for days, so use a throwaway wallet. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu") and tap App Status (testTag "DrawerAppStatus")
Verify a row titled "Emergency Exit" (testTag "Status-spark_exit") sits under Lightning Connection (testTag "Status-lightning_connection") and reads "In progress", since savings paid the funding
Verify Lightning Connection (testTag "Status-lightning_connection") reads "No open connections", not "Using Spark"
Tap the row and verify the exit's progress screen (testTag "SparkExitProgress") opens
Tap "OK" (testTag "SparkExitProgressOk") and verify App Status shows again with the "Emergency Exit" row still there
